institutional_scope: Court of Appeals of Ohio, Eleventh Appellate District

remedy.notes: The Eleventh District struck the May 19, 2025 application to reopen, removed counsel, made a disciplinary referral and credited the full $2,000 already paid against its $2,000 fine. The Supreme Court of Ohio accepted review on July 21, 2026 (No. 2026-0547). Its calendar lists the case for the January 27, 2027 oral argument session.
